item.title: La Nuu, International Photography Festival of Rubí
item.description: The contemporary photography festival of Rubí, La Nuu, frees photography from enclosed spaces and spreads it through the streets of the city. There are no rooms or display cases: the works are printed on giant banners and hung on squares and façades. The result is a festival you walk through on foot, one that lets you look at contemporary photography with the same freedom with which you look at the city.
